fields.why: Coverage is reported for each county SVI tertile (3 groups) in Tables 1 and 2 and described as 'similar across ... SVI'.
SVI is an area index and so SES under the SPD table; urban-rural has only two groups, and staff type, facility size and region are not SPDs.
The article states that no statistical comparisons were conducted, so the SVI tertile values are only set side by side.

brief_issues: SVI here is attached to facilities' counties; the brief excludes rurality of non-human units but says nothing about an area index of a workplace. A's reading (SES, as HCP characteristics) is the more defensible one.
